calls.video_title: Is it Safe to Buy Salesforce Stock Right Now? | CRM STock Analysis
calls.thesis: Reiterates buy after the rebound from under $150: revenue reaccelerated to 13%, AI upsell lifting seat pricing, record 12.7% ROIC; 14.6x forward P/E near historic lows.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $280 vs $233 = ~20% upside over 12-18 months.
calls.bull_case: High switching costs keep enterprise customers sticky; AI products improve the value proposition.
calls.bear_case: OpenAI/Anthropic-style agents could bypass Salesforce altogether.
